description: Immutable two-regime feedback control for the two-layer EBM. Cold and warm surface-temperature regimes use different positive climate-feedback coefficients; every sampled finite transition is required to remain safely inside its starting regime so exact fixed-regime matrix-exponential propagation is valid.
fit_policy: Fit one no-intercept linear map from [surface temperature, deep temperature, forcing] to next state as the raw global control. Fit a second no-intercept map on regime-gated blocks [cold*x, warm*x], where x is the same three-column state/forcing vector. Both use numpy.linalg.lstsq with no regularization.
interpretation_boundary: The feedback discontinuity is never traversed by an accepted transition. This rung tests local regime-dependent dynamics and representation of regime semantics; it is not a solver for threshold-crossing climate dynamics or evidence for a real feedback threshold.
